content: Late delivery means an order was delivered after its estimated delivery date. In this project, this is represented using the engineered field is_late_delivery in the orders table.

Freight ratio is the ratio of freight_value to item price or total item value. A higher freight ratio may indicate costly shipping relative to product value and can be a sign of logistics inefficiency.
Satisfied customer is represented by the engineered field is_satisfied in review_orders. It is typically derived from review score thresholds and used for customer experience analysis.
Repeat customer is represented by is_repeat_customer in the customers table. It indicates whether a customer has made more than one order in the dataset.
Seller performance can be assessed using a combination of order count, late delivery rate, average review score, freight ratio, and revenue contribution.
